title: Bob McGrew’s Arda debuts at $1.5B with AI for factories
hook_text: Arda debuts at one point five billion.
script:
Arda just debuted with a valuation of one point five billion dollars.
Former OpenAI executive Bob McGrew launched the company to build factory automation.
The startup focuses on bringing advanced intelligence to manufacturing facilities.
McGrew previously worked as the chief research officer at OpenAI.
Venture capital firms backed the massive round to scale industrial software.
Would you trust Arda to run an entire factory floor?
